# Amiga Impact — 2006 community award

- Original title: Robin Hood remporte l’Amiga Games Award 2006
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.amigaimpact.org/2007/02/robin-hood-remporte-lamiga-games-award-2006-1778/)
- Author / publisher: Daff; Amiga Impact
- Language / date: French; 2007-02-04
- Access: Complete short report and ranking inspected through indexed text; direct retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

Daff reports that Robin Hood won the Amiga Games Award for 2006, ahead of Snow Bros and Primate Plunge. The article prints a ten-game final ranking and links Obligement, which organized the award.

This is evidence of reception in the Amiga/MorphOS community, distinct from reviews of the original Windows edition and from awards claimed for the opening cinematic. The report does not supply vote totals or the voting method, so it cannot establish how representative the result was.
